g.text: Four NONLATCHING relays: RLY1 K3/K4; RLY2 K5/K6; RLY3 K7; RLY4 K8.

g.desc: Four NONLATCHING relays: RLY1 K3/K4; RLY2 K5/K6; RLY3 K7; RLY4 K8.

g.text: BENCH ONLY: no Nissan harness, ECU, pedal, brake, or steering connection.

g.desc: BENCH ONLY: no Nissan harness, ECU, pedal, brake, or steering connection.

g.text: COIL_5V is switched only; no external supply or energy storage may feed this net.

g.desc: COIL_5V is switched only; no external supply or energy storage may feed this net.

g.text: Flyback diodes lengthen release: dropout/bounce/skew must be measured.

g.desc: Flyback diodes lengthen release: dropout/bounce/skew must be measured.

g.text: JPWR1: regulated 4.75-5.25 V, 150 mA current limit, physical series enable upstream.

g.desc: JPWR1: regulated 4.75-5.25 V, 150 mA current limit, physical series enable upstream.

g.text: G6K pins1(+)/8(-) coil; poleA3 COM/2 NC/4 NO; poleB6 COM/7 NC/5 NO.

g.desc: G6K pins1(+)/8(-) coil; poleA3 COM/2 NC/4 NO; poleB6 COM/7 NC/5 NO.

g.text: JCTRL1 inputs active HIGH: >=2.60 V at header; LOW <=0.4 V; default disconnected OFF.

g.desc: JCTRL1 inputs active HIGH: >=2.60 V at header; LOW <=0.4 V; default disconnected OFF.

g.text: COIL_PERMIT comes from external independent supervisor. This board has no watchdog.

g.desc: COIL_PERMIT comes from external independent supervisor. This board has no watchdog.

g.text: All contact nets are isolated from logic GND. Source simulator provides its own references.

g.desc: All contact nets are isolated from logic GND. Source simulator provides its own references.

g.text: K7/K8 remain independent. Mixed states are testable here and are not declared vehicle-safe.

g.desc: K7/K8 remain independent. Mixed states are testable here and are not declared vehicle-safe.

g.text: Passive NC bypass depends on healthy contacts and connector continuity; no stuck-contact claim.

g.desc: Passive NC bypass depends on healthy contacts and connector continuity; no stuck-contact claim.
